handoff: Review #3: approve. Unit 1093 pass, typecheck green, docs:emit clean; review #2's blockers hold (config table from schema, HC11, duplicate-id lint); 228 pinned ids match the old PRD+SPECs; no stale pointers. Minor only: AGENTS.md:86 glossary-lint scope stale, change-history wording in RULES CP10/CP12/§16 intro, README first-story steps in prose (QA judges B1/B39), lint edge cases (absolute /plugins/ filter, fence styles, slug corners).

findings.title: Glossary lint scope stale
findings.detail:
Says the lint covers README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md and this file; since B7 it also covers docs/ and .agents/RULES.md (repo.test.ts:111 allDocs).
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Name docs/ and .agents/RULES.md in the list.

findings.title: Some change-history wording in rules
findings.detail:
Heading 'Names, plugin and what goes away', CP10/CP12 'Removed: … parseCockpitLine', and §16 intro 'ported from ai-engine (the earlier norn)' (line 644) read as history. The ids must stay; the HC4/5/8/16 'Replaced by' stubs are acceptable.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Reword as present-tense rules.

findings.title: First-story steps described, not shown
findings.detail:
Output is captured for init and the empty status; steps 1-5 describe the triage item, gate and PR in prose. Acceptable under B39's 'few output examples'; QA (B1, B39) judges it.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Optionally show the status line of the first ready item.

findings.title: plugins filter on absolute path
findings.detail:
allDocs(ROOT).filter(f => !f.includes('/plugins/')) drops every doc if the checkout lives under a /plugins/ folder, so the glossary sweep passes having scanned nothing.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Filter on the path relative to ROOT.

findings.title: Link/anchor lint edge cases
findings.detail:
Fences tracked only as ```, not ~~~ or 4-backtick; slug() drops \p{M}, keeps link URL chars in headings, and strips a trailing '#' in 'C#'; reference-style links and HTML hrefs unchecked; decodeURIComponent throws on a stray '%'. None occur in today's docs.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Harden when a doc needs it.

findings.title: Small fragilities
findings.detail:
cell() escapes | but not backticks; workflowLine reads a one-line description only; typeName reads 'Duration' off the schema description; test/support/docs.ts exports URL shadowing the global; docs-emit.ts holds logic the unit test imports (could live in src/reference.ts).
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Tidy opportunistically.
